title: feat(spec): a form view's thank-you panel is translated through _views.VIEW.submitBehavior

_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoKFwjoByiJo4bxxAeWE6jk3)_

Fixes #28004

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: follow-up #28215 (skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md `_views.{view_name}` row, with the next i18n skill edit)

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：表单视图的感谢页（`submitBehavior` 为 `thank-you` 时的 `title` / `message`）有了翻译键 `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW.submitBehavior.title` / `.message`，`translateView` 会把它套到下发的表单配置上；提取器和 lint 也认这个键。
- 为什么改：公开表单用别的语言打开时，标题和字段都已翻译，提交后的感谢页却还是作者写的原文，没有任何键可以翻它。
- 风险与回滚：只放宽（新增可选键），已有翻译包不受影响；只翻作者写了的 thank-you 文案，其他三种提交行为不动；被租户改过的文案照旧以改过的为准。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` 的 `translateFormSubmitBehavior`，`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` 的 `_views.submitBehavior`，`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts` 的 `pushFormViewCopy`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/system/i18n-resolver.form-thank-you.test.ts`，预期 11 条全绿。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A form view's `submitBehavior: { kind: 'thank-you', title, message }` is the confirmation a form shows after a submit, and the public form path defaults to it. The strict `_views` translation entry declared no key for it and `translateView` never read `config.submitBehavior`, so a public form read in another language confirmed the submit in the authoring language under a translated heading and translated field labels.

- **Spec, the key (`translation.zod.ts`).** The `_views.VIEW` entry gains `submitBehavior: { title?, message? }` (strict). It is nested the way the authored copy is nested, so the panel's heading never shares a key with the form's own `title` (one key cannot stand for two source strings, the same reason `emptyState.title` is nested). Its inner aliases mirror the thank-you member's own (`heading`, `text`, `body`, `description`). `url` and `kind` carry `guidance` prescriptions, since neither is display copy and `kind` is what an author copying the authored block would bring along. `thankYou` on the view node names `submitBehavior` as the rename.
- **Spec, the overlay (`i18n-resolver.ts`).** `translateView` calls a new `translateFormSubmitBehavior` beside `translateFormTitle`, reading `objects.OBJECT._views.VIEW_KEY.submitBehavior.{title,message}` on the same locale chain and the same view key. Rules, each the form title's: only a `kind: 'thank-you'` panel is touched; only an authored non-empty string is translated (a key cannot invent a `message` the form leaves to the console's default); a missing key keeps the authored string; ADR-0029 D9.2a override beats the catalog, judged per string through the one `valueOverridesPackagedBase` against the packaged view's `config.submitBehavior` (a packaged view with no panel makes every served string authored). The `config` reference is kept when nothing changes.
- **The extractor (`packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts`).** A new `pushFormViewCopy` emits a served form's `_views` tails, `title` and `submitBehavior.title` / `.message`, and both form sites (container forms through `pushContainerFormTitles`, and a `viewKind: 'form'` item) call it. So `os i18n extract` scaffolds the keys and the coverage report counts an authored panel a supported locale leaves untranslated. A non-thank-you kind records both keys unauthored, exactly as an untitled form records `title`.
- **The lint (`packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts`).** `FORM_ONLY_VIEW_TAILS` = `title`, `submitBehavior`. A `submitBehavior` key over a list view is refused like a `title` key is, and the default form's key is legal for those two tails only.
- **Showcase (`examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts`).** The showcase authors two thank-you panels (`showcase_inquiry` `formViews.contact`, the public `/forms/contact-us` web-to-lead form, and `showcase_contact` `formViews.create`). The extractor now counts their four authored strings for zh-CN, so zh-CN gains them and `check:i18n-coverage` stays at its baseline (`none new`, below). This file was added to the claim's surface by the seat's amendment.
- **Generated.** `content/docs/references/system/translation.mdx` (`gen:docs`) and `docs/audits/2026-07-unknown-key-strictness-ledger.counts/system.md` (`gen:strictness-ledger`, one more strict object).
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/28004-form-thank-you-translation.md`: `@objectstack/spec`, `@objectstack/cli`, `@objectstack/lint`, all `minor`, with both declaration lines.

**The public door really runs the translator.** `packages/rest/src/form-routes.ts:353` calls `translateMetadataDocument('view', match.view, bundle, { ...this.translateOptionsFor(i18n, locale), packagedBase: … })` inside `GET /api/v1/forms/SLUG`, and `:357` serves `view.config` as the response's `form` when the matched form is the item's `config`; the response carries `Vary: Accept-Language` (`:403`). The console's `FormPage` reads `loaded.form.submitBehavior` (`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx:2577`) and draws the authored `title` / `message` (`:2957`–`:2958`), so the translated panel reaches an anonymous visitor with no ui change. The internal `/_console/forms/NAME` path reads the view through `/meta/view`, which `meta-item-read-gate.ts:3062` already sends through `translateView`.

**Shape not taken.** Flat keys on the view node (`thankYouTitle` / `thankYouMessage`) would also close the gap, but they invent names the authoring schema does not have and sit beside the form's `title`, the exact two-strings-one-node confusion the `title` key was built to avoid. The nested key mirrors `submitBehavior.title` / `.message` as authored.

## Tests

Every run below is on head `af93f347` unless noted.

- `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.form-thank-you.test.ts` (new, 11): parsed fixtures (container through `ViewSchema`, bundle node through `ObjectTranslationDataSchema`); zh-CN overlay on a named form and on the default form; the fallback chain; a missing key keeps the authored panel; a panel without a `message` gains none; a `redirect` behavior is untouched and keeps its `config` reference; the panel key and the form-title key do not cross; override beats catalog per string, and a packaged view with no panel makes every served string authored; no mutation; the schema face (`url` refused as `unrecognized_keys` at the panel path, `kind` refused with the prescription).
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-form-thank-you-coverage.test.ts` (new, 5): the walker emits both slots per container form and per form item under the runtime key; authored copy seeds and unauthored (and non-thank-you) copy does not; no slot on a list view; the extracted skeleton parses; coverage reports exactly the authored strings a locale leaves untranslated and none once covered.
- `packages/cli/test/i18n-form-title-coverage.test.ts`: its path filter now matches the view node's own `title` only, so the new `submitBehavior.title` slot one level down does not enter the title pin.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts` (+3): a panel accepted over a named form, the default form and a form item; refused over a list view; the default form's key stays a non-key for a tail beside the panel.

## Acceptance notes

- **ui half.** No ui edit is in this PR. On the read above the console already draws the served panel, so the follow-up `domain:ui` card the order reserves may turn out to be a verification-only item; the seat decides.
- **A page's `object-form` component.** `ObjectFormPropsSchema.submitBehavior` (`packages/spec/src/ui/component.zod.ts`) is the same thank-you block authored on a page component (the showcase's `new-project-wizard` page uses one). It is translated through the page's own component tree or not at all, and this PR does not touch it. Noted, not filed.
- **Skills.** `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` lists the `_views.{view_name}` tails; teaching `submitBehavior.title` / `.message` there is owed (line above) and stays off this PR to keep it off governed paths.
